cover_observations: Backside002 shows recessed gear cavity bounded by a raised perimeter sealing land, not just a constant-thickness circular wall.
Seven visible through-hole bosses follow the asymmetric main gasket around the large lobe and elongated leg.
Lower boundary opposite the open main-gasket path forms a curved pan-seal bridge around the crank seal end.
Front001/003 show crank-seal boss, exterior ribs and threaded cross-axis holes at the lower pan edge. Count of all pan-edge holes is not established from these views.
Pioneer front specimen shows matching broad topology and circular seal seat. Cast circular surface mark is not treated as a measured cam axis.

seven_hole_visual_correspondence.limits: Perspective oblique. Cyclic/order correspondence only; no homography, metric coordinates, cover thickness or engine datum registration accepted.

five_hole_strip.finding: Both Fel-Pro kits show the strip; Dorman635-109 image009 isolates only the seven-hole main gasket and007 shows cover/main gasket. No readable manufacturer installation instruction identifies the five-hole strip.
five_hole_strip.rejected_inference: Do not assume the strip is the entire OS34601R front end, install it on top of the one-piece gasket, or infer five pan bolts from its holes. Kit coverage may include service variants; not established here.
five_hole_strip.next_evidence: Obtain applicable kit instruction/component list or factory drawing explicitly identifying the strip and junction procedure; keep it absent until then.
